d: Beneath the surface of the world's rivers and lakes, Jeremy Wade encounters creatures that are as fascinating as they are difficult to find! From a giant Pacific halibut in Alaska and a seven-foot wels catfish to the mysterious Dusky Carp and the Giant Pike Menace, these expeditions bring him closer to some extraordinary aquatic species. He also investigates killer whales hunting salmon and encounters remarkable fish around Lake Garda and the Fitzroy River.
